title: Missed Trades and No-Trade Decisions
hook: Not trading is a decision too. Know when price left without you, and when the chart never earned a trade.

launchpad.outcome: Tell an entry from a missed trade, apply the 1H rule, and make a confident no-trade decision when the sequence is incomplete.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Why is a missed retest not a trade?

takeaways: If price never returns to the zone after BOS #3, it’s a missed trade, not a trade. Don’t chase.
BOS #3 alone is never an entry. The entry waits for the retest.
Between the previous 1H swing high and low, without meaningful directional confirmation, don’t force a trade.
An incomplete sequence is a no-trade decision.
remember: NO RETEST, NO TRADE. DON’T CHASE.

slides.headline: No trade is a real decision.
slides.line: Sometimes price leaves without you, and sometimes the chart never earns a trade. Both times, you stay out on purpose.

slides.headline: BOS #3 printed, then price just left.
slides.line: The demand zone is active. Press the button and watch for a return to it.

steps.caption: Price keeps climbing. It never returns to the zone, so there is no retest.

check.prompt: Price is running higher without you. What do you do?

options.label: Buy now so you don’t miss the move
options.feedback: That’s chasing. The entry model only applies when price returns to the zone, and it didn’t.

options.label: Nothing. No retest means no trade
options.why: Right. After BOS #3 you wait for price to return to the zone. If it never does, you don’t chase it. That’s a missed trade, not a trade.

slides.headline: Find BOS #3, then watch what price does.
slides.line: Bearish context. The supply zone has formed. Find the candle that activates it.
slides.ask: Tap BOS #3: the first 5M candle that closes below the low Correction #2 pulled back from.
slides.why: That’s BOS #3. The supply zone is now active, so you wait for price to come back up to it.

after.caption: Price keeps falling and never returns to the zone. It’s a missed trade. No retest, no trade.

slides.headline: Same zone. Two different endings.
slides.line: BOS #3 activates the zone. What happens next decides whether there’s a trade.

cards.label: Price returns to the zone
cards.sub: That’s the retest. The entry model can apply.

check.prompt: BOS #3 printed and price never came back. Was a trade executed?

options.label: Yes. BOS #3 confirmed the setup
options.feedback: No entry comes from BOS #3 alone. BOS #3 activates the zone, and the entry waits for the retest.

options.label: No. A missed retest is a missed trade, not a trade
options.why: Exactly. You only have a trade when price returns to the zone. Missing one is part of the strategy, not a mistake.

slides.headline: Stuck between the 1H swings? Don’t force it.
slides.line: Before any 5M sequence, check where price sits on the 1H.

notes.text: 4H: bullish · lower area of the range · correcting

steps.text: These are the previous 1H swing high and swing low.
Price is trading between them, with no meaningful directional confirmation yet.

check.prompt: Price is between the previous 1H swing high and swing low, with no meaningful directional confirmation. What do you do?

options.label: Look for any 5M zone and take it
options.feedback: The 5M sequence doesn’t replace the bigger picture. Between the 1H swings with no directional confirmation, you don’t force a trade.

options.label: Don’t force a trade. Wait for the story to get clearer
options.why: Right. When price is between the previous 1H swing high and low without meaningful directional confirmation, you don’t force a trade.

slides.headline: The zone formed. BOS #3 never did.
slides.line: Bullish context. Press the button to play Correction #2 and what comes after it.

steps.caption: Correction #2 leaves a last bearish candle: a potential demand zone.
Buyers never close above the high Correction #2 pulled back from. BOS #3 never happens.

check.prompt: Price drifts back into the potential zone. Is this a trade?

options.label: Yes. Price is back in the demand zone
options.feedback: That zone was never activated. A zone is not active just because the opposite-colour candle appeared. BOS #3 must occur.

options.label: No. The sequence is incomplete without BOS #3
options.why: Right. BOS #3 must occur before the retest-entry model applies. An incomplete sequence is a no-trade decision.

slides.headline: Four reasons to stay out.
slides.line: Tap each card. If any of these is true, the decision is no trade.

cards.label: Between the 1H swings
cards.sub: No meaningful directional confirmation. Don’t force it.

cards.label: Zone invalidated
cards.sub: A 5M candle closed beyond the zone’s far edge.

cards.label: No retest
cards.sub: Price never came back. It’s missed. Don’t chase.

slides.quote: Missing a trade costs you nothing. Chasing one can.

slides.prompt: In your own words, what’s the difference between a missed trade and a trade, and when do you choose no trade?
slides.modelAnswer: A trade only happens when the full sequence completes and price returns to the active zone. If BOS #3 prints and price never comes back, it’s a missed trade, not a trade, and I don’t chase it. I also choose no trade when the sequence is incomplete, when the zone is invalidated by a 5M close beyond its far edge, or when price is between the previous 1H swing high and low without meaningful directional confirmation.
